verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference is a fair axis for a game engine, so the story applies. The pack shows static class-reference pages (EditorScript, EditorInterface) but nothing interactive and no runnable examples embedded in the docs. EditorScript's in-editor File > Run is a separate editor feature, not runnable API-reference examples, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
